hero.title: Empowering Tribal Youth Through Higher Education & Digital Opportunities
hero.subtitle: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) • National Fellowships • Transparent Disbursal
hero.quote: Education is the greatest instrument for social empowerment and national dignity. Through transparent digital delivery, Direct Benefit Transfer, and merit-based assistance, we are committed to ensuring every tribal scholar has the wings to pursue excellence in higher education and research.
hero.quoteAuthor: — Vision for Inclusive Tribal Higher Education & Research

about.title: About UDAAN SCHOLAR PORTAL
about.subtitle: Unified Digital Access & Advancement Network • Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA)
about.card1Desc: The UDAAN Scholar Portal is an advanced, AI-enabled scholarship management ecosystem under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA), Government of India. It centralizes premier scholarship and fellowship programs—including the National Fellowship for Higher Education (NFST), National Overseas Scholarship (NOS), and Top Class Education Scheme—under one automated, student-centric umbrella.
about.card2Desc: Equipped with smart OCR document parsing, automated deficiency detection, and real-time scrutiny tracking, UDAAN reduces scholarship processing turnaround from months to mere days. Students can securely manage their digital credentials via DigiLocker, submit annual renewals with one click, and receive milestone SMS and email notifications at every stage.
about.card3Desc: By routing funds through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into verified student bank accounts, UDAAN eliminates leakages and intermediaries. The portal features dedicated grievance redressal, interactive voice assistance, and full multilingual accessibility in English, Hindi, and Santhali (Ol Chiki) to empower tribal communities across remote regions.

events.ev3Desc: Application deadline for master’s and doctoral programmes in QS top-500 foreign universities extended. Eligible ST scholars are encouraged to submit pending visa and admission letters.

events.ev4Desc: Central share of post-matric scholarship funds sanctioned directly into verified bank accounts across 18 participating States and Union Territories through the Public Financial Management System.

reviews.title: Student Reviews & Testimonials
reviews.subtitle: Real experiences from tribal scholars pursuing research, master’s degrees, and top-tier technical education
reviews.r1Feedback: The transition to UDAAN’s AI-enabled document verification saved me countless administrative visits. My fellowship stipend was approved and credited directly via DBT in record time, letting me focus completely on my anthropological fieldwork in tribal heritage without financial worries.
reviews.r2Location: University of Leeds, UK (Home: Mayurbhanj, Odisha)
reviews.r2Feedback: Pursuing higher studies at a world-class foreign university was a lifelong aspiration for my family. UDAAN made the NOS application crystal-clear with step-by-step guidance, prompt deficiency notices, and timely living allowance disbursal straight to my international student account.
reviews.r3Scheme: Top Class Education Scheme for ST Students
reviews.r3Feedback: Direct benefit transfer through PFMS meant my semester tuition fees, hostel charges, and laptop grant arrived before the academic session began. The transparent tracking dashboard gave my parents complete confidence and peace of mind.
reviews.r4Feedback: The multilingual portal interface in Hindi and Santhali helped my family follow every stage of my research grant with pride. Annual renewal submission took less than five minutes through the DigiLocker integration. Truly an empowering portal for tribal youth!
